copy.curiosityHook: How can ordinary people carry out savage crimes yet genuinely remember nothing about what they have done?
copy.description: In Kiyoshi Kurosawa's unsettling crime mystery, a frustrated detective investigates a string of gruesome murders carried out by everyday people who retain no memory of committing the acts.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, immersive psychological dread with a measured investigative rhythm, suited for focused solitary viewing.
copy.whyWatch: It grounds a chilling procedural puzzle in pure dread, blending crime investigation with psychological horror to deliver an absorbing, deeply unsettling mystery.

allowedMaterial: Perpetrators have no recollection of their actions
excludedMaterial: Identity or mechanism of the culprit/hypnotist
Detective's ultimate fate or later narrative revelations
